january.title: January Birthstones
january.about: People born in January are traditionally associated with Garnet, Rose Quartz, and Red Jasper. Each gemstone is believed to symbolize unique positive qualities and is often chosen based on personal preferences, spiritual guidance, or individual birth details.

aboutList.desc: Traditionally associated with confidence, inner strength, courage, and new beginnings.

aboutList.name: Rose Quartz
aboutList.desc: Traditionally associated with love, emotional balance, harmony, and compassion.

aboutList.name: Red Jasper
aboutList.desc: Traditionally associated with stability, grounding, protection, and determination.

stones.name: Garnet
stones.subtitle: The Stone of Strength & New Beginnings
stones.description: Garnet is the primary birthstone for January and has long been admired for its rich red color and spiritual symbolism. It is often chosen by individuals seeking confidence, courage, motivation, and positive life changes. Garnet is also a popular choice among business owners, entrepreneurs, working professionals, and students who wish to embrace new opportunities with determination and focus.

stones.name: Rose Quartz
stones.subtitle: The Stone of Love & Emotional Harmony
stones.description: Rose Quartz is a beautiful pink gemstone traditionally associated with love, compassion, and emotional well-being. It is often chosen by people seeking harmony in relationships, self-love, inner peace, and emotional balance. Many also prefer Rose Quartz during meditation and spiritual practices to encourage calmness and positivity.

stones.name: Red Jasper

stones.description: Red Jasper is a natural gemstone traditionally associated with stability, grounding, and protection. It is often chosen by business owners, working professionals, students, and spiritual seekers looking to develop focus, resilience, determination, and steady progress in life.
